About.metaDescription: Anastasiia Shashkova — product designer with 4 years of experience in B2B SaaS, web services and digital products.
About.title: Hi, I’m Anastasiia – Product Designer with 4 years of experience in B2B SaaS, web services, and digital products
About.intro1: Contributed to 40+ product and client projects. I design user flows and interfaces from research and prototyping through development handoff and design review.
About.intro2: I have worked on products at different stages, from launching MVPs from scratch to developing existing services and design systems. I collaborate with Product and Project Managers, developers, and marketing teams, translating business requirements and user needs into clear product solutions.
